Al Jazeera live blog "Iran war live: IRGC says supertanker hit naval mine in Hormuz, catches fire", fetched 08:12 BST (page summary block; individual entries not rendered)

Iran's IRGC says a supertanker carrying over two million barrels of crude oil has caught fire after striking a naval mine while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through an "unauthorised" route.
US President Donald Trump claims the US Navy's "effective" blockade has stopped all Iranian ships from crossing the Strait of Hormuz.
